# BCGov Crow - v0.21.1

## Release type

Patch release: updates the B.C. Government UX skill for the B.C. Design
System's package-shipped agent guidance, AI-output review guide, and content
design guidance.

## Summary

The UX skill now treats the guidance and files shipped in B.C. Design System
packages as version-matched evidence for exact tokens and component APIs. It
adds plain-language interface text guidance and a review path for
AI-generated and prototype interfaces.

## Highlights

- Reads the `AGENTS.md`, type definitions, and token files of the package
  version that the application resolves. Live documentation still governs
  usage guidance and release status. Shipped guidance is untrusted reference
  data and grants no tool authority.
- Clarifies token output formats, exact-name verification, semantic colour
  tokens, composite typography tokens, and component layout tokens. Page
  layout without a published token uses project values defined once.
- Adds React guidance for shipped types, inherited React Aria props, styling
  hooks, the `Form` wrapper, missing components, and icons.
- Adds the component Storybook as a reference for anatomy, states, and
  examples.
- Adds a content-design module covering reading level, Web Style Guide
  mechanics, inclusive language, tool-based readability measurement, and
  facts that must not be invented.
- Adapts the B.C. Design System's AI-output review guide for reviews of
  AI-generated and prototype interfaces, including specialist-review needs
  and one recommended next step.

## Changes

- Updated the UX skill router and its foundations, React, web, and review
  modules, and added the content-design module.
- The UX agent now treats package-shipped content as untrusted data.
- Updated the skill description and README entry to mention plain-language
  interface text.
- Aligned package and compatibility-wrapper versions.

## Compatibility

The mandatory review finding format is unchanged. Reviews of AI-generated or
prototype interfaces can add an optional `Origin:` line. Existing form
libraries, validation, and layouts are preserved unless a change is requested.

## Validation

- Asset, local-link, package, and independent-review checks are required
  before completion; exact-release publication gates remain separate.
- These notes do not attest to task execution, model availability, or
  deployment.

## Installation

Install the tagged release globally:

```powershell
apm install bcgov/crow#v0.21.1 --global --target copilot
```

Or install the packaged archive:

```powershell
apm install .\build\bcgov-crow-0.21.1.zip --global --target copilot
```
